data.title: Denial of cost coverage for orthopedic insoles (Muster BKK)
data.case_title: Health insurance: insoles claim denied (Muster BKK)
data.summary: Muster BKK, David Muster's statutory health insurer, rejected his request to cover sensomotoric orthopedic insoles prescribed by Dr. Beispiel, citing that they are not listed in the Hilfsmittelverzeichnis and have unproven therapeutic benefit. It will cover the cost of two pairs of conventional insoles instead, minus the statutory co-payment.
data.explanation: Your health insurer decided not to pay for the special sensomotoric insoles you applied for, but will pay for conventional insoles instead (minus your statutory co-payment). If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with Muster BKK; the app shows until when. If you do nothing by then, the decision becomes final. You do not have to act if you accept the decision; you can just claim the conventional insoles as covered.

key_facts.quote: vielen Dank für Ihren Antrag vom 02.04.2025 und die Verordnung von Dr. Beispiel.

key_facts.label: Reason for the denial
key_facts.value: not listed in the Hilfsmittelverzeichnis, therapeutic benefit not proven
key_facts.quote: Sensomotorische Einlagen sind nicht im Hilfsmittelverzeichnis gelistet; ihr therapeutischer Nutzen ist nicht nachgewiesen (§ 33 SGB V).

key_facts.label: Partial approval
key_facts.value: two pairs of conventional insoles, minus statutory co-payment
key_facts.quote: Die Kosten für zwei Paar herkömmliche Einlagen übernehmen wir abzüglich der gesetzlichen Zuzahlung.
